arxiv-2012-03028.title: ParaNet: Deep Regular Representation for 3D Point Clouds
arxiv-2012-03028.creator: Qijian Zhang 1 Junhui Hou 1∗ Yue Qian 1 Juyong Zhang 2 Ying He 3 1 Department of Computer Science, City University of Hong Kong 2 School of Mathematical Sciences, University of Science and Technology of China 3 School of Computer Science and Engineering, Nanyang Technological University {qijizhang3-
arxiv-2012-03028.description: Abstract Although convolutional neural networks have achieved remarkable success in analyzing 2D images/videos, it is still non-trivial to apply the well-developed 2D techniques in regular domains to the irregular 3D point cloud data. To bridge this gap, we propose ParaNet, a novel end-to-end deep learning framework, for representing 3D point clouds in a completely regular and nearly lossless manner.

arxiv-2104-08524.title: Multilingual and Cross-Lingual Intent Detection from Spoken Data
arxiv-2104-08524.creator: Daniela Gerz, Pei-Hao Su, Razvan Kusztos, Avishek Mondal, Michał Lis, Eshan Singhal Nikola Mrkšić, Tsung-Hsien Wen, Ivan Vulić PolyAI LimitedLondon, United Kingdom {dan,eddy,ivan}@polyai.com
arxiv-2104-08524.description: Abstract We present a systematic study on multilingual and cross-lingual intent detection from spoken data. The study leverages a new resource put forth in this work, termed MInDS-14 , a first training and evaluation resource for the intent detection task with spoken data.

arxiv-2202-10313.description: Abstract High-frequency ground motion simulations pose a grand challenge in computational seismology. Two main factors drive this challenge. First, to account for higher frequencies, we have to extend our numerical models, e.g., by considering anelasticity, or by including mountain topography.

arxiv-2212-04140.title: Safe and Efficient Switching Controller Design for Partially Observed Linear-Gaussian Systems
arxiv-2212-04140.creator: Yiwen Lu, Yilin Mo
arxiv-2212-04140.description: Abstract Switching control strategies that unite a potentially high-performance but uncertified controller and a stabilizing albeit conservative controller are shown to be able to balance safety with efficiency, but have been less studied under partial observation of state. To address this gap, we propose a switching control strategy for partially observed linear-Gaussian systems with provable performance guarantees.

pmc-12619390.title: Polystyrene and low-density polyethylene degradation by Bacillus cereus L1 isolated from plastic contaminated wastewater
pmc-12619390.creator: Syeda Saira Iqbal, Yasir Rehman, Muhammad Afzaal, Sikandar Ali, Sami A Al-Hussain, Rab Nawaz, Iqra Nasim, Ali Irfan, Magdi E A Zaki
pmc-12619390.description: BackgroundThe environmental disruption caused by enduring pollution has been aggravated by the excessive use of low-density polyethylene (LDPE) and polystyrene (PS) plastics due to their non-biodegradable composition. Microbial bioremediation could be an environmentally friendly approach to degrade these pollutants. In this research, plastic-degrading bacteria were isolated from plastic-polluted wastewater collected from a wastewater drain.

pmc-13366475.title: Chiropractic students’ perceived preparedness in diagnosing and managing headache disorders at a selected university
pmc-13366475.creator: Tamia Abrahams, Ashura Abdul-Rasheed
pmc-13366475.description: ObjectiveTo explore and describe master’s chiropractic students’ self-perceived preparedness in diagnosing and managing headache disorders.MethodsA qualitative, exploratory, descriptive design was used. Thirteen master’s chiropractic students participated in semistructured interviews guided by an interview protocol. Interviews were thematically analyzed using Tesch’s 8-step approach.ResultsParticipants reported and expressed limited preparedness and low initial confidence in diagnosing and managing headache disorders.

pmc-13413867.description: HighlightsHigh entropy shape memory alloys with B2-B19′ or B2-B19 transformation are reviewed.Martensitic transformation temperature, shape memory effect, and superelasticity are summarized.Machine learning for predicting martensitic transformation temperature and thermal hysteresis is reviewed.AbstractThis review summarizes the development of Ti-based high-entropy and multi-principal element shape memory alloys (SMAs), with a particular focus on TiZrHfCoNiCu, TiHf(Zr)Ni(Pt)Pt, and TiPd-based systems.
